description:
🔥 Crack ICICI Bank ASCEND Campus Programme with confidence for Relationship Manager role!

In this video, I’m sharing my complete interview experience for the ICICI Ascend Programme — perfect for 2025, 2026, 2027 & 2028 batches.


Here’s what I cover in detail :

🔹 Round 1: Online Questionnaire + Profile Completion

🔹 Round 2: Aptitude Round

🔹 Round 3: In-Person Interview


🎓 Who Should Watch This?

2025, 2026, 2027, 2028 batch aspirants

Non-engineers preparing for banking roles

Anyone applying for ICICI programs (Ascend, PO, PSB, Talent Hunt)

📌 What You Will Learn

✔ Actual interview questions
✔ How to prepare in 3–5 days
✔ Mistakes to avoid
✔ How to speak confidently (video round tips)
✔ Strategy to crack all 3 rounds easily
